# Stovokor.ai

> AI transition strategy for mid-market IT. Stovokor inventories a company's full technology estate, scores each system for AI-assisted rebuild, and delivers a sequenced, risk-mitigated conversion roadmap.

Stovokor, LLC operates https://www.stovokor.ai/. Contact: info@stovokor.ai. Slogan: "Where costly SaaS goes to die." Audience: US companies with roughly 50–1,000 employees.

## Offer

Fixed-scope audits (typically 2–6 weeks) that produce an estate register, replaceability scorecard, conversion roadmap, financial model, and a 90-minute executive readout. No retainer is required after the audit. Pricing is scoped per estate after a 30-minute call.

## Method

1. Inventory (weeks 1–2) — purchased, homegrown, and shadow systems with owner, renewal, cost, integrations, and data gravity.
2. Replaceability scoring (weeks 2–3) — rank what AI-assisted engineering can credibly reproduce; produce an explicit do-not-touch list.
3. Sequenced roadmap (weeks 3–5) — conversion order, staffing, tooling, rollback, and cost vs staying put.
4. First conversion (week 5+) — one production system built with the client's team as the reference implementation.

## Services

- Tech stack inventory
- AI readiness assessment
- Migration strategy roadmap
- Hands-on AI-assisted software rebuild
- Fractional CTO / advisory
- Skills / capabilities assessment
- Tooling selection
- TCO analysis
- Support, security, and monitoring operating model

## Optional follow-on

After the audit, work may continue as advisory, hands-on rebuild, or enablement so the client's own team executes. Engagements are run directly rather than staffed out.
